title: smtp/main.rs DKIM block has no comment explaining why signing is done at drain-time not enqueue-time
description: The PR description / context says 'signing happens at drain time so t= timestamp is fresh per attempt'. This is a deliberate and non-obvious design choice. The code in queue.rs drain_once contains no comment explaining why signing is deferred rather than done at enqueue time. A contributor who sees the signer available at enqueue could reasonably move signing there to 'simplify' the drain — which would break the t= freshness property. Add a comment in queue.rs explaining the t=-freshness rationale.
